title: ROUND (SQL) | InterSystems SQL Reference | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: SELECT ROUND(5.99,0) AS RoundUp, ROUND(5.5,0) AS Round5, {fn ROUND(5.329,0)} AS Roundoff
SELECT ROUND(5.99,0,1) AS Trunc1, ROUND(5.5,0,1) AS Trunc2, {fn ROUND(5.329,0,1)} AS Trunc3
SELECT ROUND(-0.987,2,0) AS Round1, ROUND(-0.987,2,1) AS Trunc1
SELECT {fn PI()} AS ExactPi, ROUND({fn PI()},4) AS ApproxPi
SELECT Salary,ROUND(Salary, -3) AS PayBracket FROM Sample.Employee ORDER BY Salary
SELECT {fn ROUND(987,-3)} AS Round1, {fn ROUND(487,-3)} AS Round2, {fn ROUND(987,-4)} AS Round3, {fn ROUND(987,-5)} AS Round4
